Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. The Kiwis have taken a 1-0 lead in this two-match T20I series. These two sides will cross swords again in the final game of the series on 5th August, 2022. The action is set to begin at 8.30 pm IST (3.00 pm GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye.

Mitchell Santner the skipper of New Zealand says that it was a challenge, probably a slow wicket but they did well to get to close to 150 and he says they bowled well up top. Adds that the quick-fire cameo from James Neesham was good. He helped them get close to 150 which was enough in the end. Mentions that wickets in the Powerplay slowed the batters down a bit.

Scott Edwards the captain of Netherlands says that the bowlers did pretty well and restricting them to 148 was pretty good. He says that they didn't get a good start and Kiwis bowled well upfront. He praises the spinners for their effort. He ends by saying that there were a few positives to take from this game and they will look to execute their plans better in the next game.
Stay tuned for a few interviews...

Earlier, Netherlands bowlers bowled with great discipline to restrict New Zealand to a low total. If it was not for a 20-run penultimate over, they would have been chasing much less. Most New Zealand batters got starts but didn’t go on to make it big with Martin Guptill the top-scorer with his 45. The stage looked set for an upset but the New Zealand pacers returned to the field with intent. In the end, the result was as we expected and once again the minnow has fallen just short of the finish line.

New Zealand began their defense in absolutely stunning fashion with Blair Tickner taking three wickets in his first two overs. After that, it was pretty much cruise control mode and the bowlers went through the motions. They never looked challenged and the only player to put some resistance was Bas de Leede. However, there was very little he could do all alone. The pace bowlers were outstanding for New Zealand with Tickner taking four as he added the wicket of Bas de Leede towards the end. Ben Sears also contributed with three wickets and the two spinners got one each.

Netherlands started the chase tentatively and never seemed to get a move on. They were scoring at under six runs per over right from the start up till the later stages of their innings. They lost three wickets really early after which they were always chasing the game. Bas de Leede was the only player to apply himself and show any sort of intent. He played almost the whole innings with very little support from the other end. He scored 66 runs off just 53 deliveries and gave a slight ray of hope to his side.

Despite having to chase a moderate total, Netherlands have fallen short of the total. New Zealand bowlers have done well to seal this win after their batters put on a disappointing show earlier. In the end, it is a comfortable 16-run win and New Zealand have taken an unassailable 1-0 lead in this two-match series.

OUT! TAKEN! Blair Tickner grabs his fourth wicket and wraps the game up! An excellent effort from Bas de Leede! He was the lone warrior in this chase. Blair Tickner pitches this one up, around middle and off. Bas de Leede lifts this one high towards long on. But the ball goes off the toe end and flies high towards the fielder there. Daryl Mitchell settles under it and takes a good catch. New Zealand win by 16 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Good running! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Bas de Leede lifts it over the bowler's head and towards long off. Two taken! 17 needed off 4 balls!
FOUR! A perfect start to the over for Netherlands! A fuller ball, outside off. Bas de Leede makes room and drives it powerfully through cover for a boundary! 19 needed off 5 balls!
Full again and outside off, Bas de Leede drills it to deep point for another single. 23 runs needed in the last over.
Goes full and around off, Clayton Floyd tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A full toss and on off, Bas de Leede digs this towards backward point for a run.

FOUR! It is too little too late now. This is banged short on middle and off, Bas de Leede looks to pull it but gets beaten by the pace. The ball deflects of his gloves and goes past the keeper towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Full and on middle and off, Bas de Leede looks to heave it over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge to the leg side.
Clayton Floyd is the last batter for Netherlands.

OUT! RUN OUT! Martin Guptill with a quick pick up and throw and gets his man. This is on a length and on off, Shariz Ahmad pushes it to the off side and sets off for the single. Martin Guptill at short cover runs to the ball picks it up and hits bullseye at the bowler's end. Shariz Ahmad is well short of his crease and has to continue running towards the hut. New Zealand one wicket away from victory. 30 needed off 11 now!
A length ball, around middle. Shariz Ahmad looks to flick this one but the ball goes off the leading edge and away from the fielder at mid off. A quick single taken! 30 needed off 12 balls!
FOUR! A loud cheer in the crowd! A shorter ball, around middle. Shariz Ahmad goes towards the off side, and pulls it gently towards fine leg for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Bas de Leede dabs it towards point for a single.
Shariz Ahmad is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two overs for Ben Sears! Netherlands' hopes are hanging by a thread now! A fuller one, outside off. Ryan Klein tries to go over mid off, but he fails to put any power on that. He gets more elevation than distance. Mitchell Santner at mid off, runs across a bit and takes a good catch. 36 needed off 15 balls!
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Santner b Ben Sears

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Bas de Leede backs away and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Wide! Fuller one, wide of off. Bas de Leede leaves it alone. Wide called!
On a length, around off. Ryan Klein drags it with the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Just what Netherlands needed. He gets to his fifty in style as well. This is full and on middle, Bas de Leede moves across and smokes it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie. This has been a brilliant knock under pressure. Now can he take the Netherlands to a famous win?
Short again and on middle, Ryan Klein pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! SLAPPED! This is short and around off, Ryan Klein stays back and slaps it over the mid off fielder for another boundary. They need a lot more of those.
This is full and on off, Bas de Leede shuffles across and sweeps it towards backward square leg for a run.
Length delivery around off, Ryan Klein pushes this of his back foot through covers for a single.
EDGY BUT FOUR! This is on a length and on middle, Ryan Klein makes room to work it to the off side but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper and towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Ryan Klein has walked out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Another stunning catch and it's that man again, Glenn Phillips! Ben Sears gets his second wicket of the game! He drops it short, around off. Tim Pringle stays in his crease and pulls this one. The ball flies high towards deep square leg off his top edge. Glenn Phillips runs across to his right, covers a lot of ground, and takes a stunning catch. He has made a tough catch look very easy here! Netherlands are now 7 down!
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Ben Sears

Commentary.Commentary: Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Bas de Leede flicks it towards square leg for a single.
On a length now, outside off. Tim Pringle opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards point for a single.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, shorter one this time. Tim Pringle looks to slash this one but he fails to get any bat on it.
EDGED AND FOUR! On a length, outside off. Tim Pringle looks to go over mid-wicket but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the keeper and towards third man for a boundary.
Shorter ball, around middle and leg. Bas de Leede makes room and pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
Continues bowling on a good length and just outside off, Tim Pringle clips this towards short mid-wicket.

Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a good length and sticks to the outside off stumps line. Bas de Leede looks to fend and gets an inside edge back down onto the pitch. They rush across for a quick single.

SIX! BANG! He connects this one alright! Lockie Ferguson pulls his length back a fraction and comes at the a good height outside off. Bas de Leede pulls this hard over the deep square leg fence for a maximum! Bas de Leede is the beacon of hope for Netherlands.
On a good length and just outside off, Bas de Leede looks to pull but is not short enough. Goes under his bat to the keeper.
This is on a good length and Lockie Ferguson follows the batter as he looks to make room leg side. Mistimes his shot towards wide long on for a brace.
Lockie Ferguson serves this on a length and outside off, Bas de Leede looks to slap this offside and mistimes it towards point.
Lockie Ferguson (2-0-7-0) is back on!
Quicker one, short and on off, skids through too, Tim Pringle punches it to covers.

Short again and on middle, Tim Pringle slaps it with his inner half towards long on for a brace. The fielder there throws at the batter's end and they appeal for a run out. It looks close but the umpire says no.
Darts this one down the leg side, Bas de Leede tucks it through square leg for one.
A bit short and on middle, Tim Pringle forces this to long on of his back foot for a single.
Tim Pringle comes to the crease.

OUT! BOWLED! Ish Sodhi gets his first wicket. This is slower through the air and on off, turning in, Logan van Beek does not pick the googly and goes for the drive towards covers but plays down the wrong line and misses the ball completely. The ball goes on to rattle the stumps. Netherlands are in deep, deep, trouble!
Swing and a miss! This is floated on off, turning away, Logan van Beek has a wild swing at it but gets beaten.
Angles this one onto the pads on a fuller length, Logan van Beek paddles this towards short fine leg and takes a single.
Short this time and wide outside off, Bas de Leede thumps this to deep cover-point for an easy single.
Loops this up full and wide outside off, Bas de Leede looks to swing and gets beaten on the outside edge by the turn.
Flights this ball full and outside off, Logan van Beek plays this down to long off for another run.
Short once again and outside off, Logan van Beek rocks back and punches the ball too deep cover for a single.
Mitchell Santner sees the batter come down the wicket and fires this short and into the pads. Bas de Leede knocks this down to long on for a run.
Back of a length again, around middle and leg. Logan van Beek hangs back and looks to flick this one but he misses and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Pitches it up now, outside off. Logan van Beek drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Another short ball, around middle. Logan van Beek shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
Logan van Beek is the new man at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Ben Sears comes into the attack and strikes! Wickets in quick succession for New Zealand! Netherlands are under immense pressure now. Ben Sears hits the deck hard as he serves a short ball, outside off. Teja Nidamanuru looks to pull this one but he manages to get a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Dane Cleaver jumps and takes a fine catch. Netherlands have lost half their side now!
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Ben Sears

Commentary.Commentary: Much fuller now, around middle. Teja Nidamanuru pushes it back to the bowler.
Slightly shorter, outside off. Bas de Leede gets on his toes and dabs it towards point for a single.
Shorter one, down the leg side, an arm ball. Teja Nidamanuru looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Floated on middle, Teja Nidamanuru leans on and blocks it out.
Tossed up full and on middle, Bas de Leede nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.

Darts this one down the leg side, Bas de Leede looks to flick it but gets off balance and misses it. Dane Cleaver collects the ball and takes the bails off in a flash. They are appealing for a stumping but the umpire is not interested. However, the replay shows that his foot was still in the air when the bails were taken off. A lucky escape for Bas de Leede. Also, it is called a wide.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunning catch by Glenn Phillips to get rid off Scott Edwards. This is floated on middle and off, Scott Edwards sweeps this hard and flat wide of deep mid-wicket. It looks like it is in the gap but Glenn Phillips runs to his right and takes terrific diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Pushed through quciker and short, Bas de Leede stays back slaps it to long on for a run.
Short and on middle, Scott Edwards pulls it of his toe end through square leg for one.
Googly this time and angling down leg, Scott Edwards looks to glance this put gets pad past the keeper for a leg by to fine leg.
Short this time and in line with the stumps, Bas de Leede clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Bas de Leede is looking good here! Ish Sodhi flights this one full and outside off, Bas de Leede strokes this along the ground as the ball rushes to the deep cover fence for four runs!
Ish Sodhi flights this one full and outside off, Bas de Leede is down the track and mistimes the ball wide of long on and they take two runs.
WIDE! Floats this one full and really wide outside off. Bas de Leede leaves it alone and is called wide by the umpire.
Quicker delivery bowled full and outside off, Bas de Leede fends this towards cover.
Ish Sodhi bowls a googly from a shorter length and outside off, Scott Edwards cuts it to deep point for a single.
Pulls his length back now, serves a shorter one, outside off. Scott Edwards chops this one towards deep cover. A single to end the over!
Wide! He spills this down the leg side. Wide called!
SIX! KABOOM! Great use of the feet! Fuller ball, slower through the air, around off. Scott Edwards shimmies down the pitch and smokes it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
Floats this one up, serves it full, around middle. Bas de Leede miscues his sweeps shot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, pitches it up again, on middle. Bas de Leede blocks it out.
Tosses this one up, full and around middle. Scott Edwards sweeps it towards short fine leg. Another run taken!
Shorter, quicker, outside off. Bas de Leede dabs it towards third man and takes a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Bas de Leede uses his feet again to take it on a full and drives it to covers for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
A bit short and around off, Bas de Leede goes back in his crease and lofts it wide of the long off fielder and collects two more runs.

Tossed up full and on off, Bas de Leede skips down the track and smashes it wide of long off and calls for two. His partner responds to it and they are off. The fielder there throws the ball towards the bowler's end but Ish Sodhi cannot gather it and the batter completes the two runs.
Darts this one full and down the leg, Scott Edwards looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball deflects and the keeper cannot collect it properly. A leg bye taken.
Short and outside off, Bas de Leede stays back and punches it through cover-point for one.
Ish Sodhi starts with a flatter delivery,short and on middle, Bas de Leede uses his feet to work it to the leg side but misses and gets hit on his thigh pads.
It will be spin from the other end! Ish Sodhi comes into the attack.
Mitchell Santner bowls this slower in the air and serves it full and outside off, Scott Edwards fends the ball towards the point fielder. Just four runs conceded in the over.
Mitchell Santner pulls his length back outside off as he sees the batter giving it the charge. Bas de Leede knocks the ball to long off for a run.
Mitchell Santner gets this full and angling into the pads, Bas de Leede clips the ball towards mid-wicket.
Flighted full outside off once again. Scott Edwards sweeps this fine towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Full once again and outside off, Bas de Leede gets an outside edge towards short third man and they take a quick single.

Mitchell Santner starts with a flighted delivery full outside off, Scott Edwards gets a good stride forward and looks to fend. Hits his pads and rolls towards covers as they take a leg bye. Huge appeal but this is clearly hitting the pads outside off stump.

Back of a length, around middle. Scott Edwards miscues his pull shot towards fine leg. Lockie Ferguson fumbles a bit there and allows the batters to take a run! 14 runs off the over! Netherlands are 30 for 3 at the end of the Powerplay!

FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Netherlands are making full use of the final over of the Powerplay! This is fuller and outside off. Scott Edwards leans forward and drives it through cover for yet another boundary!

FOUR! Edgy boundary, but Netherlands will not mind that! Shorter ball, outside off. Scott Edwards stays in his crease and looks to push this away towards cover. But the ball flies off the outside edge away from the keeper and towards third man for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Bas de Leede dabs it towards third man for a single.
Fuller now, around middle. Bas de Leede plays it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Bas de Leede greets James Neesham with a boundary! That should release some pressure! He starts off with a length ball, wide of off. Bas de Leede advances down the pitch and slashes it past cover-point for a boundary.
He bowls this on a good length and angling down the leg, Scott Edwards goes for the pull but misses. He is expecting the umpire to call it a wide but the umpire says it is a fair delivery.
Another appeal for caught behind but turned down again. This is on a length and on off, Scott Edwards tries to push it to the off side but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes full again and on middle, Bas de Leede works this to mid on for a single.
Full and on middle, Bas de Leede tucks it towards mid-wicket.

This is on a good length and on middle, angling in, Bas de Leede looks to flick it but gets beaten by the pace. The ball goes to the keeper of his pads. There is an appeal for caught behind but turned down.
This is full and on middle, Bas de Leede knocks it back to the bowler. Lockie Ferguson grabs it and throws it towards the batter and shows some aggression.
The skipper of Netherlands, Scott Edwards makes his way out in the middle. Can he get his side out of trouble?

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Second wicket in the over! Blair Tickner bangs this is in short and wide outside off, Tom Cooper slashes at the ball and gets a thin outside edge to the keeper. Dane Cleaver takes an easy catch behind the wickets and the bowler celebrates. Tom Cooper stays at the wicket and after a long while the umpire raises his finger. Blair Tickner and New Zealand have their third.
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Full once again and straying down leg, Tom Cooper looks to work this leg side and just clips his pads on the way to the keeper.
Blair Tickner goes full this time and angling this into the stumps, Tom Cooper clips this into the air just above the square leg fielder and gets a couple of runs.
Beaten! Blair Tickner serves this from back of a length and outside off, Tom Cooper feels for the ball and misses as it whooshes past the outside edge.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Tom Cooper looks to pull and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tom Cooper walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! Max O'Dowd tries an obnoxious shot and loses his stumps! Blair Tickner serves this full and straight in line with the stumps, Max O'Dowd shuffles across the stumps and tries to scoop this one. Completely misses the ball, and falls flat on the floor trying to keep it out. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Blair Tickner gets his second and Netherlands in some trouble.
FOUR! Crunched! Width on offer this time, slightly shorter. Bas de Leede rocks back and slashes it powerfully past point for a cracking boundary.
Shorter one again, outside off. Bas de Leede gets on top of the bounce and taps it towards cover.
Back of a length now, outside off. Bas de Leede stands tall and taps it towards cover-point.
Very full this time, on the pas. Max O'Dowd flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Angling in now, another length ball, around middle and leg. Max O'Dowd looks to flick this one but he misses. The ball lobs up towards point off his thigh pad.
Ben Sears begins with a length ball, outside off. Max O'Dowd makes room and tries to go over cover but he misses.
Ben Sears comes into the attack.
Pulls his length back and on off, Bas de Leede gets on top of the bounce and pushes it towards covers.
Goes full this time and on middle, Max O'Dowd nudges it towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length and on off again, Max O'Dowd opens the face of his bat and knocks it to point.
On a length and on off, Bas de Leede guides it towards third man for a single and gets off the mark.
This is beautiful bowling. A good-length delivery around off, shaping away a bit, Bas de Leede moves his bat at the last moment and lets it go to the keeper.
Bas de Leede walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Blair Tickner gets the breakthrough in his very first ball. This is short and angling down the leg. Stephan Myburgh looks to pull it to the leg side but it is too close to his body and he only manages to glove it towards the keeper. Dane Cleaver takes a simple catch moving to his right. Netherlands loses their first.
Commentary.Howout: c Dane Cleaver b Blair Tickner

Commentary.Commentary: Who will bowl from the other end? Blair Tickner it is!

Lockie Ferguson ends the over just the way he started! Good-length delivery just outside off, get the ball to shape away a fraction. Max O'Dowd hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten on the outside edge. 6 runs from the first over.
This is on a good length outside off, Stephan Myburgh slashes the ball wide of third man for a single
Goes full outside off, Stephan Myburgh looks to drive but mistimes the ball towards cover.
WIDE! Serves this full and angling down leg, Stephan Myburgh looks to clip this but misses. The umpire calls this one wide.

FOUR! First boundary for Netherlands! Lockie Ferguson is a fraction short and angled the ball into leg stump, Stephan Myburgh flicks this off his waist towards the deep backward sqaure leg fence for four runs.
Angles this one in full into the pads, Stephan Myburgh digs this one out back to the bowler.
What a start from Lockie Ferguson! Serves this on a good length and just outside off and 'round the wicket. Straightens after pitching and beats the outside edge by a fraction.
